ann.t: Appointment — Crayons Advertising Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/s. Vaish & Co. Chartered Accountants as Statutory Auditors of the company w.e.f. September 28, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Crayons Advertising Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Updates — Crayons Advertising Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Press Release pertaining to audited financial results for the half year and year ended 31st March 2026'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Crayons Advertising Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Updates — Crayons Advertising Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Declaration under Regulation 31(4) & 31(5) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 '.
Resignation of Independent director — CRAYONS ADVERTISING LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Independent director.
Resignation — Crayons Advertising Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Vinod Zutshi as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. February 16, 2026.
Awarding of order(s)/contract(s) — Crayons Advertising Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
